subject.title: Tailscale serve mode lacks optional secondary authentication

question: Should OpenClaw accept gateway.auth.requireTailscaleSharedSecret, or an equivalent opt-in contract, as the supported way to compose Tailscale Serve identity with token/password Gateway auth?
rationale: The request changes a Gateway authentication boundary and adds public config surface, so automation cannot choose the permanent security policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve Layered Auth Contract
options.body: Accept the linked PR's token/password-only layered Tailscale Serve auth contract after branch refresh and normal checks.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Require additional validation, docs, or naming changes before making the new auth setting public.

options.title: Defer To Broader Design
options.body: Keep this issue open for a broader decision covering Tailscale identity, trusted-proxy behavior, warnings, and Control UI pairing before merging code.

recommendation.title: Approve Layered Auth Contract
recommendation.body: Accept the linked PR's token/password-only layered Tailscale Serve auth contract after branch refresh and normal checks.
